name: Solid Voxelization via Octree
definition: A technique to convert a set of 3D line segments into a solid voxel representation using an octree data structure, allowing for efficient ray intersection testing against the solid volume.
summary: Solid Voxelization via Octree converts 3D line segments into a solid volume representation using hierarchical subdivision to store only occupied regions, distinguishing itself by explicitly computing solid occupancy rather than just surface presence.
